variables.name: MODE_PGDATA
variables.description: Mode required on the cluster data directory.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: umask required for the postgres OS user. Leading zeros are ignored, so 077, 0077, and 77 match.

variables.name: LOG_FILE_MODE
variables.description: Comma-separated log_file_mode values the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: UNIX_SOCKET_MODE
variables.description: Comma-separated unix_socket_permissions values the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: SYSLOG_FACILITY
variables.description: Comma-separated syslog_facility values the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: LOG_MIN_MESSAGES
variables.description: Comma-separated log_min_messages values the check accepts. An unset value is treated as warning. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: ERROR_VERBOSITY
variables.description: Comma-separated log_error_verbosity values the check accepts. An unset value is treated as default.

variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.description: Comma-separated log_timezone values that pass without matching the OS zone. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: WEAK_HBA
variables.description: Comma-separated pg_hba methods that fail the host-auth check.

variables.name: POST_AUTH_DELAY
variables.description: Required post_auth_delay. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: WEAK_CIPHERS
variables.description: Comma-separated ssl_ciphers tokens that fail the check.

variables.name: ECDH_DISABLED
variables.description: ssl_ecdh_curve value that fails the check.

variables.name: AUTOVACUUM_LOG_OFF
variables.description: log_autovacuum_min_duration value that fails the check.

variables.name: ROTATION_AGE_OFF
variables.description: log_rotation_age value that fails the check.

variables.name: BACKSLASH_QUOTE
variables.description: Comma-separated backslash_quote values the check accepts.

variables.name: ISOLATION
variables.description: default_transaction_isolation text the check requires. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: IDLE_TX_OFF
variables.description: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout value that fails the check.

variables.name: PASSWORD_ENCRYPTION
variables.description: Comma-separated password_encryption values the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: ROTATION_SIZE_OFF
variables.description: log_rotation_size value that fails the check.
